answer: Recursive ZK-STARK reputation commitments anchor identities within an immutable ledger, ensuring that any attempt to harbor malicious Sybil clusters triggers an immediate slashing of staked collateral. By integrating VRF leader sortition with sequential delay functions, we impose a quartz precision on block proposals that renders identity cloning computationally infeasible under Byzantine conditions. This oasis of verifiable randomness stabilizes the network, where the negative expected utility of attack vectors guarantees a robust Nash equilibrium against all non-collusive adversaries.
